fund_name: Call for proposals to support the development of innovative medical countermeasures for chemical, biological, radiological and nuclear threats (HERA) - Medicinal products
summary: This call aims to improve the European Union’s readiness to respond to chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear (CBRN) health threats by supporting the development of medicinal products, including vaccines and treatments that are threat-agnostic and based on platform technologies, especially targeting biotoxins. The action focuses on advanced research and innovation to bridge the gap towards regulatory approval and market readiness, enhancing preparedness against CBRN threats through development of medicinal countermeasures.
reporting_requirements: Regular project progress and financial reports as required by EU grants
Compliance with EU health and safety regulations
Delivery of milestones towards medical countermeasure development and market readiness
